item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-11 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-04 Automatica

The research programme focuses on the development of nonlinear Data-Driven Predictive Control methodologies for dynamical systems subject to stochastic uncertainty. The activities will investigate the design of explainable control algorithms capable of exploiting information from data to describe and predict the behavior of nonlinear dynamical systems. Particular attention will be devoted to uncertainty characterization and management, the interpretability of control laws, and the analysis of closed-loop stability, robustness, and performance guarantees. The proposed methodologies will be evaluated through numerical simulations and, where feasible, experimental validation.

Deadline: 2026-12-10 15:00
Institution: Politecnico TORINO, Torino
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-02 Meccanica applicata alle macchine

The project aims to develop a computational fluid dynamics model of a fuel cell for marine applications. The model will be used to study reactant distribution, pressure losses, and mass and heat transfer, with particular attention to the uniformity of flow and temperature fields. The effects of feed and cooling conditions and channel geometry on the fluid flow and thermal behaviour of the cell will be analysed under operating conditions representative of onboard use. The results will provide guidance on operating conditions and geometric configurations that can improve reactant distribution and thermal management in fuel cell systems for marine applications.
